- 1990s: 16 books, 67 reviews, average rating 3.82
- 2000s: 47 books, 286 reviews, average rating 4.28
- 2010s: 88 books, 1257 reviews, average rating 4.61
- 2020s: 21 books, 110 reviews, average rating 4.66

The decade of publication with the highest average rating (among decades with >= 10 distinct rated books) is the 2020s, with an average rating of approximately 4.66 across 110 reviews of 21 distinct books.
